name: C'Thun's Legacy
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The walls of Ahn'Qiraj tremble. A force of evil, older than the world itself, has been destroyed.

As you look at the remnants of the colossal abomination your heart nearly freezes. Even in death you can feel the legacy of C'Thun's evil around you.

You have done what was thought to be impossible.

You grab at an eye stalk of the fiend, stowing it safely in your pack.

Take the Eye of C'Thun to the dragons in the next chamber.
narrative.objectives: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Caelastrasz in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.
narrative.offerRewardText: We will leave this place on our own, Lady adventurer - once we are certain that the evil within has been wholly destroyed. Your journey of legend is almost at an end.
narrative.requestItemsText: Lady adventurer, you have freed us of its grasp.
